title: Optimal stability of complement value problems for p-Lévy operators
summary: We establish the optimal convergence of solutions to integro-differential equations (IDEs) governed by symmetric integrodifferential $p$-Lévy operators, $1 < p < \infty$, in the presence of nonlocal Dirichlet or Neumann boundary conditions. For illustrative purposes, consider the particular case of the (fractional) $p$-Laplacian $(-Δ)^s_p$ with $0 < s \le 1$.
